title: Min Bit Flips to Convert Number

monster.name: Transformation Wraith
monster.title: Morpher of Integer States
monster.defeatQuote: Minimum bit flips to transform start into goal!

description: A bit flip of a number `x` is choosing a bit in the binary representation of `x` and flipping it. Given two integers `start` and `goal`, return the minimum number of bit flips to convert `start` to `goal`.
starterCode:
def minBitFlips(start: int, goal: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def minBitFlips(start: int, goal: int) -> int:
    diff = start ^ goal
    count = 0
    while diff > 0:
        diff &= (diff - 1)
        count += 1
    return count
hints: The answer is the Hamming weight of (start ^ goal).
